title: Run the snapshot workflow before anything else is built
problem: Every availability and injury claim rests on a single capture, so no delta, no trend and no point-in-time replay exists
proposed_change: Turn on fl2-lines-snapshot.yml so three dated captures per week are retained with hashes and drift alarms
missing_information_to_decide: Nothing - the work is unblocked and it is the only change that unlocks R06 R21 R29 R30 R34 R46 R54 R55 R61
risk: Store growth and Pages build time; mitigated by committing manifests only, not raw bodies

title: Acquire snap counts in CI and stop calling participation a depth measure
problem: snap_participation.csv lists who took a snap but not how many, so replacement depth cannot be measured and the 100% play-rate trap is live
proposed_change: Extend the workflow to build a per-game snap-share series per position group and publish its row counts in the manifest
missing_information_to_decide: Whether the release snap file covers 2026 in the schema the parser expects
recommendation: Adopt; gate the deficiency feature on it

title: Fix the depth-chart parser for the 2025/2026 12-column schema
problem: The mirror holds 784,796 depth rows for 2026 but depth_player.csv contains 0 of them, so every depth claim dies at ingest
proposed_change: Branch the parser on the header instead of assuming the 2020-2024 columns, and fail the build when a season yields zero rows
missing_information_to_decide: Nothing - the defect is already reproduced
risk: Silent behaviour change for 2020-2024 rows; cover with a golden-file test
recommendation: Adopt before building any depth feature

title: Decide the price source rather than inheriting a mirror
problem: Opening prices do not exist for 2026 and closing prices carry no timestamp, so CLV cannot be certified
proposed_change: Pick one: (a) record our own dated snapshots of a public consensus page, (b) buy a feed, (c) price without a market benchmark and drop CLV from the gates
missing_information_to_decide: Terms and redistribution rights for any operator price; the owner's budget
risk: A price feed the project cannot legally republish would poison the leaderboard
recommendation: Decide before Week 12; publish the decision as a one-line policy change

title: Keep the leaderboard empty until escrow fills
problem: Publishing a backtest ranking invites the reader to treat it as a live result
proposed_change: Render only escrow rows; keep every historical number on the evaluation page
risk: An empty page reads as failure to some readers; mitigate with a visible countdown to n>=200
recommendation: Adopt - already implemented in this section, protect it in CI

title: Replace the 3-point injury penalty wherever it survives
problem: A fixed penalty asserts knowledge the ablation does not support (measured -0.48 pts per expected miss, CI -0.72 to -0.25)
proposed_change: Audit other sections for fixed penalties and link them to this ablation record
risk: None; it is a documentation change

title: Transcribe venues and game states from the game centre in CI
problem: 2 of 148 fixtures have a venue transcribed from the official game centre, and the ticketing widget for a Munich fixture points at the home club's stadium
proposed_change: Capture the game-centre Game Info block per fixture and store venue plus roof designation
risk: Copyright scope for republishing; store derived facts only (venue name, roof state, kickoff)

title: Move raw mirrors out of the published tree
problem: Row-level third-party mirrors sit inside a public Pages site while their terms are unread
proposed_change: Keep public pages to derived aggregates and links; relocate raw mirrors to a private store or a release asset
missing_information_to_decide: Legal read of the mirror licences and the league terms
risk: Breaks other sections' builds if they read those paths; coordinate before moving
recommendation: Decide at integration; do not do it mid-cycle

title: Publish an injury-table re-capture with a per-team row count
problem: Published counts disagree with the live page (254 rows and 4 empty sections vs 279 and 2 claimed); nobody can tell which was true when
proposed_change: Fetch every page of the official report, store it, publish the per-team count and the delta against the previous capture

title: Add the 4th-string column honestly or not at all
problem: A 1st-to-4th string matrix is the most requested view and the least supportable today: no official string data exists
proposed_change: Publish a two-string view (starter group vs everyone else) from playing time, and mark 3rd/4th as unavailable until SG-02 lands
risk: A fake 4th-string cell would be the single most damaging error on the site
recommendation: Adopt the honest subset now, expand after SG-02

title: One navigation for the six published sections
problem: Four frameworks plus two data sections each shipped their own index, so a reader cannot tell which number is authoritative
proposed_change: Root hub gains one row per section with its verification tier and its as-of date; section files stay owned by their sessions
risk: Merge conflicts on the shared hub

title: Gate the correlation panel to official numbers only
problem: Prop and price correlations were computed on mirrors; the brief restricts correlations to officially sourced numbers
proposed_change: Split the panel into Official (results only) and Market (labelled, never used as a model input)
recommendation: Adopt - implemented here, apply to other sections

title: Give the demotion gate a real trigger now
problem: The gate is defined but has nothing to demote, which is easy to forget shipping
proposed_change: Wire the gate to the escrow ledger so the first qualifying strategy inherits it automatically

title: Build the fixture-context set from the two dated league announcements
problem: Rest, window, roof and international status are published facts and are currently scattered
proposed_change: One table per fixture: kickoff UTC, broadcast window, venue, roof, international flag, rest days, all with source links
missing_information_to_decide: NWS grid join for wind and precipitation
recommendation: Adopt the schedule part now, weather as SG-15

title: Add the NWS hourly overlay behind a coverage test
problem: Wind and precipitation move totals and are absent; only 45 of 137 games carry any weather field in the mirror
proposed_change: Join the public NWS hourly grid by venue lat/lon and kickoff time, and publish coverage before any effect estimate
missing_information_to_decide: Nothing (NWS is a public federal source)
risk: Venue geocoding errors leak into a model; store the coordinate and the grid time with every row
